description: A Minecraft mod that removes any form of 6 7 (really really strict) from chat, replacing it with "bad number"

mods.name: six seven blocker
mods.description: Removes any form of 6 7 (really really strict) from chat, replacing it with "bad number". This includes things like "6 blah blah 7", "sSsIIIIXxX SEV33EENNNNN", etc
